- The white square is at cols ~47-49 (WWW)

I clicked at col 47, which is the left edge of the white square. I need to click at col ~54 (middle of ppp) to select purple.

- BBB: cols 0-2
- WWWWWWWWWWW: cols 3-13
- BBB: cols 14-16
- cc: cols 17-18
- GGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGG: cols 19-35
- c: col 36

- c: col 40

- c: col 42
- ppp: cols 43-45
- c: col 46
- GGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGG: cols 47-66
So the purple square is at cols 43-45. I clicked at col 47, which is in the G region (dark gray background). That's why the click didn't select purple.
Let me click at row 4, col 44 (middle of ppp) to select purple.
